cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?
